description: cvrt-s1: the recorded server code coverage floor for each suite, in percent. scripts/coverage-ratchet.js fails a pull request whose measured coverage is more than 0.5 percentage points below these numbers; it reads this file from the BASE branch, so a pull request cannot lower its own floor. Numbers come from CI (Linux), never from a developer machine. unit = the unit chain (scripts/run-all-tests.js) under c8 --all --include src/**; e2e = the browser suite's server coverage over src/web-ui/** (e2e.yml, without --all).
